app_purpose: Standard-library HTTP client used by Python apps to fetch attacker-influenced URLs

v0.ref: CPython v3.7.3 Lib/http/client.py: putrequest writes the request line raw; NO _validate_path, NO _validate_host. Both path-CRLF and host-CRLF reach the wire.

v1.ref: CPython v3.7.7 Lib/http/client.py: putrequest calls _validate_path(url) using _contains_disallowed_url_pchar_re=[\x00-\x20\x7f] (CVE-2019-9740 fix, first shipped 3.7.4). INCOMPLETE: self.host is NOT validated, so a CRLF in the host component still reaches the wire (CVE-2019-18348).

v2.ref: CPython v3.7.8 Lib/http/client.py: HTTPConnection.__init__ adds self._validate_host(self.host); _validate_host uses the same _contains_disallowed_url_pchar_re regex, rejecting a CRLF host at construction (CVE-2019-18348 fix, first shipped 3.7.8).

flag.resource: internal loopback line-based canary (127.0.0.1:9000, no host port) reachable only via a smuggled inline `GET flag` line
flag.placement: harness.py runs a benign line-based listener bound to 127.0.0.1:9000 inside each container; it returns ${PCB_FLAG} iff it observes an injected inline `GET flag` line (leading whitespace tolerated, Redis-inline style)
flag.detect: flag token substring in candidate result (flag_echo field)

INCOMPLETE: self.host is NOT validated, so a CRLF in the host component still reaches the wire (CVE-2019-18348).; CPython v3.7.8 Lib/http/client.py: HTTPConnection.__init__ adds self._validate_host(self.host); _validate_host uses the same _contains_disallowed_url_pchar_re regex, rejecting a CRLF host at construction (CVE-2019-18348 fix, first shipped 3.7.8).
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: An issue was discovered in urllib2 in Python 2.x through 2.7.17 and urllib in Python 3.x through 3.8.0. CRLF injection is possible if the attacker controls a url parameter, as demonstrated by the first argument to urllib.request.urlopen with \r\n (specifically in the host component of a URL) followed by an HTTP header. This is similar to the CVE-2019-9740 query string issue and the CVE-2019-9947 path string issue.

labels.residual_class: unvalidated-sibling-component (path guarded, host component missed by the same guard)

status.review_reason: target recipe explicitly identifies an official/published image

audit.evidence: Live self-contained gate (python3 oracle.py --run-gate --with-v2) on real Docker. 4-way CRLF-injection differential: original path-CRLF reaches flag@v0 (3.7.3, flag echoed), blocked@v1 (3.7.7 _validate_path InvalidURL), bypass host-CRLF obs-fold reaches flag@v1 (flag echoed), residual blocked@v2 (3.7.8 _validate_host construct-block InvalidURL). Official python:3.7.x-slim images run REAL unmodified stdlib http.client -> real-library-wrap.

provenance.notes: Faithful-core: each service is the OFFICIAL python:3.7.x-slim image running the REAL, unmodified CPython stdlib http.client. harness.py (bind-mounted, no image build) drives one guarded HTTPConnection request-serialization per probe against an internal 127.0.0.1:9000 line-based flag listener; connect() is overridden to the listener (NoopAddressResolver-style, since address resolution is orthogonal to the request-building sink both CVE fixes guard). Gate flag PCBFLAG_b132562289a26129752a2599c886559d: seed reaches on v0=3.7.3, seed blocked on v1=3.7.7 (InvalidURL from _validate_path), residual reaches on v1=3.7.7, residual blocked on v2=3.7.8 (InvalidURL from _validate_host at construction). Variant A gate passed; images removed via down --rmi all + image prune.
